fomod.Name: OSF Settings
fomod.Author: ozooma10
fomod.Description: A shared native Starfield menu for mod settings, keybindings, interface launchers and reported mod issues. Mods ship a JSON schema and OSF Settings builds their page; values persist across saves. Requires SFSE and Address Library for SFSE Plugins (1.16.244.0, v21). OSF UI is not required.
